\section*{Detection per layer of the prediction}
\label{sec:supp-layers}

A diagnostic of the macOS cells (section 6.4 of the registration): the detection measures for the trials of four layers marked by the prediction, carried out, received carry, closing key in reading, and the trials in none of the three. A trial with several marks is counted in each of its layers. Merge rate: as registered; Corrected: the merge rate of the corrected analysis of deviation D10; --: no value (no denominator, or a numerator above the denominator, deviation D10). The Windows cell has no prediction.
